audience: HR teams and shift planners who plan staff schedules in Planerio

useCases.title: Review the shift plan for the next 7 days
useCases.text: List the planned shifts between two dates with the employee, shift group, workplace and location. Read only the shifts changed since a date to see what was edited.

useCases.title: Find absences and requests waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the absence periods that overlap a date range. Include the requests that still wait for approval, so you can plan the cover.

useCases.title: Find open staffing requirements
useCases.text: List the shift cards with their validity, weekdays, times and required qualifications. Compare them with the staff supply for resource planning.

useCases.title: Look up employee master data with weekly hours
useCases.text: List the employees valid on a reference date with their shift groups, entry dates and weekly hours. Ask only for the fields the task needs.

useCases.title: Check the vacation days left per employee
useCases.text: Read the vacation allowance, carry-over, requested and remaining days of each employee for one year. This works on Planerio 1.5.
